review_method: Every candidate reviewed as a four-frame sequence, with original-resolution follow-up on selected candidates. Check anatomy, geometry, contact/support, plausible state changes, identity and scene continuity, actual progression, and prompt fidelity. Hold ambiguous details. Manual qualitative showcase selection, not a benchmark or a guarantee of error-free images.
